title: assets/data/rules/<name>.json
description: One set of game rules: how a new game is set up, when it is won or lost, and which whole systems run. The New Game screen offers every file of this folder, and a level may name one.

title.description: The name the New Game screen shows (the file's name when empty)

newGame.description: The choices of the New Game screen; a part left out is the one of rules/standard.json

presets.description: The Growing Period presets: how old the hero starts and when the leader's mantle is taken

startAge.description: The age the hero starts at

mantleAge.description: The age at which the hero takes the leader's mantle

comforts.description: The comfort levels: how hard the needs press and how full the store starts

name.description: The name of the comfort level

needsPercent.description: How fast needs fall, in percent of the normal rate

foodPercent.description: The starting store, in percent of the normal one

victory.description: When the game is won or lost; a game that reaches a threshold ends at once

winPercent.description: The share of Trade or of Religion in the region that wins it

combinedWinPercent.description: The average of Trade and Religion that wins it by the combined rule

loseBelowPeople.description: The clan with fewer people than this is defeated

rivalFollowerPercent.description: The share of a rival clan's people that can follow the hero's faith

systems.description: Switches of whole systems: a system that is off does not happen at all. Read once when a game starts. A switch left out is on.

weather.description: The weather cycle and its sky

combat.description: Enemies, and the hero's weapons against them

rivals.description: The rival clans of the region

tutorial.description: The first-day quest of a new game

markers.description: The arrow that points at the tracked quest step

chronicle.description: The lines conversations add to the clan's chronicle

politics.description: Politics between clans (read from the politics milestone on)
